name: Pro Token unrestricted executor campaign
summary: The Pro executor implementation exposed exec() without the caller allowlist added by the post-incident replacement and without a cadence or batch limit, allowing an untrusted caller to force repeated Pro sales under attacker-controlled pool conditions and extract USDT.

loss.notes: Across the 11 successful transactions from the first defect execution through 0xaaea183b...84d0, receipt-level Transfer logs show 57,969.169891681606435859 USDT paid directly by the Pro/USDT pair to attacker EOA 0x427671b2c8e91034a91fe698f9b7259b2345f45d. USDT is valued at stablecoin par. The executor also supplied 167,500 Pro to the forced swaps, while 7,404,304.727660184073717188 USDT went to its three preconfigured receivers; GoPlus identifies those receivers as protocol-designated rather than attacker addresses, so their balances and the exchanged Pro are not counted again. SlowMist's approximately $52,000 figure reflects reported attacker profit rather than this exact gross stablecoin receipt. The later 0x4baf136b...49a50 transaction came from a different EOA and helper and is outside this campaign.

ageReset.description: The proxy constructor's Upgraded event selected implementation 0x7fba63d0c45f265c1bea3ed2e49f0691a9d9aa87; this was the sole pre-campaign implementation selection.

sources.note: Reviewed the 11 campaign transactions and receipts, indexed Pro and USDT Transfer logs, proxy and implementation creation transactions/runtime bytecode, the proxy constructor's Upgraded event, exploit-time target attribution, the later remediation upgrade, and security-firm reporting. Transaction 0x6a50fe...80ff4 at block 112652246:1 is the first successful defect execution by EOA 0x427671b2c8e91034a91fe698f9b7259b2345f45d through helper 0xf00bc28d22d71be74bc8ab0d11fe77f6d77850ac; ten more same-helper transactions end at 0xaaea18...793d1. Each batch repeatedly reached exec() through proxy 0xc44f2accac20598a3f2b4d489a970fcf52a04a3c and implementation 0x7fba63d0c45f265c1bea3ed2e49f0691a9d9aa87. The artifact was deployed at block 87886213:43; the proxy was deployed by the same EOA one transaction later, and constructor log 128 selected it. No intervening implementation selection preceded this campaign; runtime hash 0x7666800a8209b6ff010f8c2513099b624472d89747dbd67b88fae41cb2cacc17 remained present. Campaign receipts reconcile exactly: executor -167,500 Pro; pair +151,425.148167480 Pro and -7,462,273.897551865680153047 USDT; configured receivers +7,404,304.727660184073717188 USDT; attacker EOA +57,969.169891681606435859 USDT. GoPlus reporting distinguishes the configured receivers from the attacker and documents the post-incident implementation's new caller check.
